g.text: TX switches: selected line -> EXC (AD7746 excitation), all others -> GND

g.desc: TX switches: selected line -> EXC (AD7746 excitation), all others -> GND

g.text: CapScan 5x5: absolute mutual-capacitance scanner for 5 TX x 5 RX printed skin sensors (characterization bench board).

g.desc: CapScan 5x5: absolute mutual-capacitance scanner for 5 TX x 5 RX printed skin sensors (characterization bench board).

g.text: U2 AD7746 measures the floating capacitance between EXCA and CIN1+: +/-4.096 pF span, CAPDAC offset up to 17 pF, 11-109 ms per conversion, I2C 0x48.

g.desc: U2 AD7746 measures the floating capacitance between EXCA and CIN1+: +/-4.096 pF span, CAPDAC offset up to 17 pF, 11-109 ms per conversion, I2C 0x48.

g.text: One taxel = one TX on EXC, one RX on CIN, the 8 other lines at GND (guarded measurement: the neighbours do not add to the reading).

g.desc: One taxel = one TX on EXC, one RX on CIN, the 8 other lines at GND (guarded measurement: the neighbours do not add to the reading).

g.text: U3 PCA9555 (I2C 0x20) drives the 10 select lines. Select is ACTIVE LOW: write 0 to connect a line to its bus. At power-up the PCA9555 pins are inputs

g.desc: U3 PCA9555 (I2C 0x20) drives the 10 select lines. Select is ACTIVE LOW: write 0 to connect a line to its bus. At power-up the PCA9555 pins are inputs

g.text: with internal 100k pull-ups, so every line sits at GND until the firmware selects one. IO0_0-4 = TX1-5, IO1_0-4 = RX1-5, IO1_5 = reference.

g.desc: with internal 100k pull-ups, so every line sits at GND until the firmware selects one. IO0_0-4 = TX1-5, IO1_0-4 = RX1-5, IO1_5 = reference.

g.text: CIN node budget: about 18 pF (one switch on) + 5 x 6 pF (switches off) + traces + sensor RX-to-GND. AD7746 limit is 60 pF to GND: keep the CIN trace short.

g.desc: CIN node budget: about 18 pF (one switch on) + 5 x 6 pF (switches off) + traces + sensor RX-to-GND. AD7746 limit is 60 pF to GND: keep the CIN trace short.

g.text: XIAO: D0 CDC_RDY (low when a conversion is ready), D4 SDA, D5 SCL (default Wire pins), D8 LED_HB, D9 LED_SENSE. USB-C and 3.3 V regulator on the module.

g.desc: XIAO: D0 CDC_RDY (low when a conversion is ready), D4 SDA, D5 SCL (default Wire pins), D8 LED_HB, D9 LED_SENSE. USB-C and 3.3 V regulator on the module.

g.text: Unused AD7746 pins (REFIN, VIN, CIN1-, CIN2, EXCB) are left open as allowed by the datasheet (internal reference).

g.desc: Unused AD7746 pins (REFIN, VIN, CIN1-, CIN2, EXCB) are left open as allowed by the datasheet (internal reference).

g.text: RX switches: selected line -> CIN (AD7746 input), all others -> GND

g.desc: RX switches: selected line -> CIN (AD7746 input), all others -> GND

g.text: Reference capacitor: C8 (C0G, +/-0.05 pF) between EXC and CIN through U14.

g.desc: Reference capacitor: C8 (C0G, +/-0.05 pF) between EXC and CIN through U14.

g.text: Select it with IO1_5 low and every TX/RX line deselected:

g.desc: Select it with IO1_5 low and every TX/RX line deselected:

g.text: the reading is C8 plus board stray. With nothing selected the reading is the zero.

g.desc: the reading is C8 plus board stray. With nothing selected the reading is the zero.

g.text: Two points = offset and gain check, through the same bus and switch type as a taxel.

g.desc: Two points = offset and gain check, through the same bus and switch type as a taxel.
